slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Tech Hive Advisory says Egypt's Personal Data Protection Centre published guidelines (consent, lawful bases, direct marketing, DPO, ROPA, licences and permits, privacy notice) and breach-notification templates to aid compliance with the law and executive regulations; no sanction is reported (date is January-February 2026, the period covered).
